parts.text:
The background color scheme, layout alignment and overlapping issues, and typography have been updated for Bright Beginnings Preschool:

- **Background Color**: Introduced a modern palette featuring `--bg-app` (`#f8fafc`) body background, `--bg-surface` (`#ffffff`) card elevations, `--bg-services` (`#f1f5f9`) contrasting section tone, a soft gradient hero banner, and polished dark navy surfaces (`#0f172a` / `#090d16`) for the navbar, contact section, and footer.
- **Layout & Alignment Overlaps**: Restructured the hero section into a responsive two-column grid to eliminate squished card image constraints; configured flexbox wrappers and consistent height alignment across service cards; resolved list item text-wrapping misalignment with dedicated check-icon containers; and added responsive mobile styling to prevent overflow clipping.
- **Font Family**: Replaced the Oswald/Roboto combination with `Outfit` for headings and brand elements, and `Plus Jakarta Sans` for clean, legible body text.
